title: Truth Has Come and Falsehood Has Perished!
body:
Dastoor yaa Sayyidee, madad. (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah

Alhamdulillah, hamdan daaiman... yaa Rabb! O our Lord, give more honor and glory to Your most beloved
and honored one, Sayyidina Muhammad (s). Also give him more from Your endless blessings for his nation,
and particularly to his followers. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)

As-salaamu `alaykum! And the first salute is to our supporter on this planet, who is sending us heavenly

support. Only if heavenly support comes, will we be able to be on the Right Path. Dastoor, yaa RijaalAllah!
O our Lord's accepted and honored servants, you can't find anything in their hearts except Allah Jalla
Jalaaluhu! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)

A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani ‘r-rajeem. Shaytan never likes to stand up; he may go to Jahannam! Also,
those people who are not happy, if they are not standing up (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu akbar! They
may go to Jahannam as well! (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Every time, if they are not standing up for the honor of
Allah Almighty, they may also go to Jehennam (Mawlana Shaykh stands). Those who are not happy to stand
up for the most honored one for Creation, they may also go to fire, Jahannam (Mawlana Shaykh sits)

If jalaalatul malik (His Majesty, the King) comes and `ulama and high-rank people, what you are saying of
them? Who is going to be on that place are not common people, but aristocracy attending for malik’s
presence. For example, they have been invited to a royal reception and until His Majesty, the King arrives,
they are not sitting. Why? Because high-level protocol people do not sit down before His Majesty comes, and
they honor him (by remaining standing).

O Salafi `ulamas! Also, if you are there you are also not sitting! You are also fearing from jalaalatu ‘l-malik to
see you sitting! It is okay to remain standing because you are waiting for His Majesty to arrive. You are saying
it is adab for such a meeting, to meet His Majesty, the King. Even for such a meeting it is permitted, but can
you, Salafi `ulamas, be there if you are not sitting, waiting for jalaalatuh to come? You are saying it is high
respect to the highest one in this kingdom.

So, you are knowing everything! But if anyone is standing up for the holy name of the Seal of Prophets (s),
you say it is bida`, haraam, shirk, kufr! From where did you learn such foolish ideas? I never heard a Wahabi
person invited for a reception and sitting before His Majesty, the King arrived. But if we say (Mawlana
Shaykh stands) the Most Honored Name, “Allah,” (you reject our standing up for that honor). From where

this tradition came? Am I bringing it from my pocket to you? From where I am bringing?

Stand up for the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands) You know this! You
have been granted more honor, more power (Mawlana Shaykh sits) because of the most beloved one (s).
During the Night Journey, it has been related that the Seal of Prophets (s) said, “I met some angels during the
Night Journey; they never sat, only they stood and glorified Allah Almighty.” Yusaabihoon Allah qiyaaman
mundhu khalaqahum Allah jalla wa `ala, “The angels are glorifying Allah since the time Allah created them.”

(From this we know) anyone who stands for the Most Honored Name of our Lord, “Allah,” that is t`azheem,
glorifying, to give their highest respect. Angels are standing throughout their lives, since the day their Lord
created them, glorifying the Majesty of their Creator. And their Creator, the Lord of all Creation, is happy that
they are standing up and giving their highest glorifying. There is in Shari`ah, qiyaas, an analogy, and this
hadith shareef:

•• •••• •••• ••• ••••
man tashabbaha bi-qawmin fahuwa minhum.
Who imitates a people is one of them.

Yes, if we are making an analogy, look at the angels standing up! If we are standing up and giving our most
high respects, it is a refused thing? Why you are not saying? You are saying it is bida`. You stand until His
Majesty, the King arrives; what is the heavenly judgment for that? Why you are not saying, "He is just like us
and we are not going to stand up." Why? Do it!

O Wahabi People! You do it also. If waiters carry you by your ears outside, you will be very happy. (laughs)

And secondly, the Seal of Prophets (s) was seeing on another level of Heavens, angels who are always in ruku,
never standing up. But they are making ruku when our Lord's Name is mentioned (Mawlana stands and bows
in ruku`). “O our Lord.” You are saying, “Just angels. Bida`! No signs from Shari`ah.” You are not
understanding Shari`ah! (Mawlana Shaykh sits) And you are not believing in the Night Journey. If you are
believing in the Night Journey, you may look and know there were countless angels glorifying their Lord in
ruku`. We may do that when His Holy Name is declared; it is for us to make ruku`, to bow. Angels are
making and we can do also.

And thirdly, the Seal of Prophets (s) was looking on a level of Heavens, angels who are all in sajda, bowing,
never taking up their heads. If we are making or bowing ourselves for glorifying our Lord, how can you say,
“That is bida`; we never saw such a thing in shari`atullah," and you are understanding shari`atullah? Study
the Night Journey; try to learn deep meanings of what is going to be granted through Ummat al-Habeeb.
Therefore, we are weak and standing up (for that honor) and you also know that!

O Salafi `ulamas! I am saying, but I am ashamed to say, that you know. You don’t know; you know nothing.
All your followers are from Wahabi no-mind people, who never taste the glorifying of Allah (swt) that is
granted to one: the most beloved in the Divinely Presence, most honored one. You can't carry this; your
understanding is to say only that “Say: ‘I am a man like you.’”?

•••• •••••••• ••••• •••••• ••••••••••• •••••• •••••••
Qul innama ana basharun mithlukum yooha 'ilayya.
Say (O Prophet), "I am but a mortal man like all of you." (18:110)
You are understanding? You imprison your understanding, closing, closing, closing it down!

Ana basharun mithlukum. Yes. Mithlukum, what does it mean? Why you are not saying to your jalaalatuh,
“You are like us. Stand up, and we will sit on your chair!” Why you are not saying to him, “Get up! Stand up.
We may sit also a little bit.” Yet he is carrying something that you are not granted. He had been granted the
dress of king. You are not dressed with that dressing, that jalaalatu ’l-malik wears, which gives honor to him;
without that you and him are on the same level. But when he is dressed in it, you can’t say, “You are like us.
Let us sit on your throne.” Those Wahabi no-mind people have not been granted any understanding. They are
saying:

••••• ••••••••• •••••• •••••••
Wa maa Muhammad illa rasool,
And Muhammad is nothing except a Prophet. (an-Nisaa, 4:28)

•••• •••••••• ••••• •••••• ••••••••••• •••••• •••••••
Qul innama 'ana basharun mithlukum yooha 'ilayya.
Say (O Prophet), "I am but a mortal man like all of you." (al-Kahf, 18:110)

What is the difference? Don’t say, “He is like ourselves.” No, you can’t say. Allah Almighty is granting to him,
yuhaa ilayy, “revealed to me,” but not to you! He is representative of the Lord of Heavens, granted to speak
on behalf of Him the divinely language! But those Wahabi no-mind people are not understanding anything!
They are so hard-hearted and they think they may do something.

How many years did this Wahabi way come in the ummah, 100 years? And for 1300 years the ummah is on
right beliefs. What did you do? You changed the ummah's understanding and put your baatil (falsehood)
understanding! For what reason are you saying mutakabbir, mutakabbir, “Arrogant and stubborn,” and that

Ahlu’l-Sunnah wa’l-Jama`ah is on the wrong way and you are on the Right Way? •••• •••••••• ••••••••••••• qul
haatoo burhanakum, “Say, ‘Bring your proof!’” (2:111) You are making big fitna throughout the ummah, and
Allah (swt) is going to punish you, here and Hereafter! Beware!

O Salafi `ulamas! (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Whatever the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s), said,
is it not a hadith, or am I bringing it from my pockets to you?
••••• ••••••• ••••••
`Alaykum bi ’s-sawaadi ’l-`azham.
Keep to the vast majority.

(Mawlana Shaykh sits) You know the meaning of this? For what? How many people are we and how many
people are following you up to today? And now you are going to be taken away from maydanu ’l-`ilm, “the
field of knowledge,” and from every direction you will be attacked! Say, defend yourselves, haatoo
burhaanukum, that we are on the wrong way and you are on the Right Way! You can’t do it because our
Prophet (s) said, `Alaykum bi ’s-sawaadi ’l-`azham, “Where there is big mass of my nation, join them and
follow them."

You are only a handful people (compared to the majority)! You are not even two hands, and although you
have every material possibility, still you can’t bring anyone as a believer in you! Only with your riyals, dollars,
dirhams, or gold you may attract some foolish ones to you and you are will blow your golden trumpet (as if it
is a great feat)!

O Allah! O Allah! O Allah jalla jalaalahu. We must correct our beliefs and understandings, and follow the big
mass of Ahl as-Sunnah wa ’l-Jama`ah. You cannot say anything against Ahl as-Sunnah wal-Jama`ah `ulama.

But I am sorry that doctors of Shari`ah and `ulama Azhari ’sh-shareef are not standing up to defend Ahl asSunnah wa ’l-Jama`ah, and they will be punished also.

I am only a small servant, trying to defend Ahl as-Sunnah wal-Jama`ah. Why those Azhari ’sh-shareef
`ulamas are writing so many books? If there is no pillow, put (their boks) under your head and sleep on
them! Why you are writing? What you are saying? Why you are not fighting, jihaad fee sabeelillah, struggling
in the Way of Allah (swt), to defend haqeeqatu ’l-Islam, “Real Islam”. If you are not doing that, noor will be
taken from your faces and a darkness will come. Then, at your last moment, you will look like some other
creature and a bad smell will come from you, and people will run from you.

O `ulama Ahl as-Sunnah wal-Jama`ah! Stand up and fight against Shaytan and shatanic ideas! That is all.
They are making me to repeat daily, until Ahl as-Sunnah wal-Jama`ah `ulama wake up!! They must know
what we are doing, and know about those Wahabi people, who are very terrible for Islam. But Islam is a tower
that no one can destroy.

May Allah forgive us and give us a good understanding for the most honored one's (s) shafa'a. Bismillahi ’rRahmani ’r-Raheem.

Fatihah.

Tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah astaghfirullah!
Tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah astaghfirullah!

(39 minutes)

This bombarding is enough for them! If anyone says it is baatil, he is going to be with Shaytan's company.

Barakah Mawlana, alhamdulillah, from Allah's Divine Generosity. Alhamdulillah wa ’sh-shukru lillah. Either
we are leaving or they are leaving! We are not going to leave, fee sabeelillah, up to end of the world. Finished!
Their provision is like a car's fuel, it is finishing with no way to replenish. Haqq, alhamdulillah wa ’sh-shukru
lillah. They are not using heavy guns, only simple ones. Heavy guns are coming now on the wrong way’s
representatives, then coming to the non-Muslim world also. Daleel is coming. Truth is revealed and falsehood
has perished!

Fatihah.
